title: Read shared-project permissions
responsibility: Converts a matching hosted project role into the actions allowed in the desktop view.

inputs.name: hostedCapabilities.value
inputs.description: The hosted project response object, including its project identity and role.

inputs.name: hostedCapabilities.projectId
inputs.description: The expected project identity; the response identity must match exactly.

outputs.name: hostedCapabilities
outputs.description: Shared-project capabilities with GitHub as source. Owners and commenters may comment; viewers may not. Agents, planning and approval are disabled, with an explanation that shared comments need server acknowledgment.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Throws for an invalid response object, a different project identity or a role other than owner, commenter or viewer.
